documented: No WWOX report documents development gained after a seizure response; four children in three reports had partial, transient or clinically-defined improvement with no recorded progress (counts from the earlier package, perimeter: four classes).
not_documented: A test of the proposition: no child had a sustained, instrumented response, so the proposition is untested, not refuted. The two seizure-free children of the 12-child series are untested candidates.
sources: E08, E09, E01 to E04; A1 table 5
wording_for_consumers: Recovery of development as a consequence of seizure control is not demonstrated in WWOX; it has not been tested by a sustained, dated, instrumented response.

documented: Partial or transient responses without documented progress: Shaukat first and second child, Tarta-Arsene, and the You 2024 case (see note on that case).
not_documented: For You 2024 the developmental statement is age-referenced and has no before/after contrast: it is not a documented stall after the response. Of the four counted as discordant, one (that case) is better coded not assessable for progression, giving three timed discordant children (INFERENZA).
wording_for_consumers: Some partial or transient responses were not accompanied by documented progress; the number of children with a timed before/after statement is three, not four.

documented: Genetic and structural DEE baseline: responder with poor development is the majority outcome (module A2), so a poor course after response is the expected case in those strata.
not_documented: The counterfactual course in WWOX. A baseline from other genes is a reference, not a WWOX control; KCNQ2 shows both a poor-outcome majority and a possible treatment-choice effect.
wording_for_consumers: We do not know the course without the response; other genetic DEEs bound what is expected but do not substitute for it.

documented: Randomised arm differences in seizures with no demonstrated developmental difference are underpowered (about one in four power in ICISS, computed in A2); unknown-aetiology infants show a developmental arm difference (UKISS, abstract level). Caregivers rate meaningful improvement at a seizure reduction well below a conventional 50 percent threshold in LGS (abstract level).
not_documented: Irrelevance of seizure reduction to development, function or quality of life is not demonstrated either: absence of a proven effect is not a proven absence. No WWOX measure of function or quality of life exists.
wording_for_consumers: It is not demonstrated that reducing seizures is irrelevant to development, preserved function or quality of life.

documented: A delay before seizure onset (cohort: delay evident from birth in all seven of one series, abstract level, module-held) shows a component of development not explained by later seizures.
not_documented: It does not exclude an additional contribution of later seizures or of treatment burden. WWOX is not classified as a fixed substrate or an irreversible course on narrative descriptions and absence of complete responses.
wording_for_consumers: A pre-onset component and a later contribution can coexist; neither is measured in WWOX.

not_documented: Per-child statements without definitions; home-observed freedom coexists with video-EEG events (E01).
wording_for_consumers: Keep clinical and electrographic endpoints apart on every card.

not_documented: You 2024 only: events persisted on video-EEG at 11 months while parents saw none.
wording_for_consumers: Do not code parent-observed absence as electroclinical freedom.

not_documented: No gain after any of the four classes. One status with recent gains outside them (E23), unattributed.
No dated before/after in any WWOX report; a lower age-standardised standing does not by itself show loss.
wording_for_consumers: Do not infer loss from a narrative of not reaching age-expected milestones.

not_documented: Not measured in the WWOX record read. One report mentions fragmented sleep with persisting hypsarrhythmia in a child with clinical control (module-held, A1 section 2).
wording_for_consumers: Missing; no inference. The caregiver global impression is the only available proxy in related disease (E10) and is not a separate measure.

not_documented: Polytherapy with up to 14 drugs listed in one child (E20); white-matter MRI signal in vigabatrin-treated children is a denominator question (module B1: 18 of 64 imaged children, cohort of mixed aetiology), not a WWOX-specific risk.
wording_for_consumers: No autonomous indication to exclude or change a therapy. Keep denominators, co-therapies, symptoms and reversibility apart.

documented: quality of life and caregiver burden
not_documented: No measure in any WWOX report read. Parent-reported function exists in one survey without treatment data (E25).
wording_for_consumers: Missing; the next WWOX series should record it before and after any response.
